GitHub

Make software changes reviewable and traceable.

GOfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

GitHub provides repositories, review workflows, and automation for software delivery. We can organize a product's source code so changes have an owner, a review record, and checks before release. This helps a business retain a usable engineering history and makes it easier to hand over a website, SaaS application, or internal tool to its own team.

Useful outputs

  • Organized repository and release history
  • Review requirements and automated checks
  • Documented contribution and deployment workflow

Where we can apply it

  • Website release: feature branch → pull request → checks → approved deployment.
  • Defect resolution: issue → reproduction → fix review → release reference.
  • Team handover: repository → setup guide → ownership transfer and operating notes.
01

Use case 1

Manage website and application code with branches and reviewed pull requests.

02

Use case 2

Run suitable build, test, and deployment checks through GitHub Actions.

03

Use case 3

Track defects and delivery work alongside the source changes that resolve them.

Inputs we need

  • Source code and repository ownership
  • Reviewer roles and release process
  • Build commands and protected credentials

Delivery sequence

  • Structure the repository and assign appropriate access to collaborators.
  • Configure review rules and checks that address meaningful release risks.
  • Connect the agreed deployment process and document recovery procedures.

Expert review points

  • Review collaborator access and branch protection.
  • Confirm CI logs and repository history contain no secrets.
